notes.title: 1.005 Update Version Notes
notes.content:
1.Comprehensively adjust the functions of items and add negative effects, aiming to give you more meaningful choices.
2.Add several new items.
3.Fix some known bugs.

notes.title: EggsNeverHurt will be officially launched on December 13th, 2024!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

I am Kurt Xie, the developer of "EggsNeverHurt". I am very grateful for your attention and even purchase!

"EggsNeverHurt" is the first game developed by me, a novice developer. I am well aware of its immaturity and that it is far from meeting the standards of a qualified commercial product. Frankly speaking, my purpose is just like the name I gave to my studio (PracticeMoreStudio), hoping to gradually become a qualified game developer through more practice. Therefore, I am even more thankful to you who have supported me by buy the game! Thank you for your tolerance, and I sincerely ask you to point out the problems in the game. I truly believe in the power of "players teaching you to make games":)

I wish you a pleasant gaming experience! (If not, please scold me, as long as it makes me understand why)

KurtXie,
PracticeMoreStudio
